data.name: Description
data.value: The files Jarvis needs to hear and speak on this PC. They are downloaded once, checked against their published checksum, and stay in the models folder.

data.name: NoCard
data.value: No NVIDIA graphics card found: Jarvis will run on the processor, more slowly. Proposed recognition: {0}.

data.name: SmallerLanguageModel
data.value: This card does not have the memory for qwen3:14b next to Whisper. On the language models page, prefer a model of 7 to 8 billion parameters, for instance qwen3:8b.

data.name: GroupHint_WakeWord
data.value: Lets Jarvis hear “Hey Jarvis”. Without it, the hotkey and a click on the orb still work.

data.name: GroupHint_EndOfSpeech
data.value: Tells when you stopped speaking. Without it, a simple sound level threshold is used.

data.name: GroupHint_Recognition
data.value: Whisper turns your request into text. One model is enough; the chosen one is used once in place.

data.name: GroupHint_Voice
data.value: Jarvis speaks French and English: one voice per language. Kokoro is a higher quality option, slower on the processor.

data.name: Model_whisper-small
data.value: Whisper small (graphics card with less memory)

data.name: Failure_Unreachable
data.value: Failed: the server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.

data.name: Failure_ChecksumMismatch
data.value: Failed: the file is not the published one (checksum). It was deleted.

data.name: Failure_DiskError
data.value: Failed: the models folder cannot be written (disk full?).

data.name: Failure_Failed
data.value: Failed: see the log for the cause.

data.name: SomeMissing
data.value: Some models are not installed; their line says why. You can try again.
